title: clock-decoded-from-hawking-radiation: code for "What does a clock decoded from Hawking radiation read?"
description: Numerical code and result files for the paper "What does a clock decoded from Hawking radiation read? Infalling proper time in quantum Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity" and the accompanying Letter. Exact Schwarzian disk amplitudes, one-sided and decoded readings of an infalling clock, replica (PSSY) decoding, the radiating Hayden-Preskill model, and random-matrix non-perturbative corrections.
